user.title: Add a screen
user.description: The screen must be on your network. On a Hikvision indoor station the next step switches ADB on with the station's admin login. On any other Android screen, turn on network ADB yourself first and accept the 'Allow debugging' prompt on the screen the first time.

data.name: Name
data.ha_url: Address the screen uses to reach Home Assistant

hikvision.title: Hikvision login
hikvision.description: The indoor station's admin login (the one for its web page). Used to switch ADB on; it tries once each time you press Submit, and stops trying for good if the station ever refuses the login, so a wrong password can't lock the station's account.

progress.installing: Installing PiPup on the screen and giving it permission to show the dashboard. This can take a minute or two.

error.hik_auth: The screen refused that username or password.
error.hik_unreachable: The screen didn't answer. Check the IP address, and that this is a Hikvision indoor station.

abort.already_configured: This screen is already set up.

data.weather_hourly: Hourly weather (optional, if your provider keeps hourly on a separate entity)
data.buttons: Big buttons (up to 6, replace the week forecast)
data.buttons_when: Show the big buttons only while this is on (optional)
data.call_entity: Intercom call entity (optional): the dashboard steps aside while it isn't idle
data.open_entrances: Let chips open gates, garage doors and doors (anyone who can reach the screen's network could)
data.return_minutes: Come back this many minutes after the exit button

banner.name: Show a banner
banner.description: Slides a banner over the dashboard.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long it stays (tap to close sooner).

tone.name: Tone
tone.description: Colour: info, good, warn or alert.

show.name: Show the dashboard
show.description: Shows the dashboard now (also ends an exit-button break).

dismiss.name: Hide the dashboard
dismiss.description: Hides the dashboard, optionally for a number of minutes.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Bring it back after this long (empty = until the next show).

restart_pipup.name: Restart PiPup
restart_pipup.description: Restarts PiPup on the screen (frees its memory) and shows the dashboard again.

install_pipup.name: Install or update PiPup
install_pipup.description: Installs the PiPup version this integration was tested with.

notice.name: Show a notice
notice.description: Puts a small pill under the clock that stays until it is cleared. Warn and alert notices can also tint the glass amber or red.

id.name: ID
id.description: A short name for this notice, e.g. bin_night. Sending the same ID again updates it.

tint.name: Tint the glass
tint.description: Warn and alert notices tint every glass panel amber or red.

tap_clears.name: Tap clears it
tap_clears.description: Let people clear it by tapping the pill on the screen.

banner_title.name: Banner title
banner_title.description: Optional. A banner slides in too, but only when this notice is new (re-sending it doesn't repeat the banner).

clear_notice.name: Clear a notice
clear_notice.description: Takes a notice off the screen.

id.name: ID
id.description: Leave empty to clear every notice.

welcome.name: Welcome home
welcome.description: Full-screen 'Welcome home, Alex' with up to three live cameras (the first one big). Closes after the set time, with a tap, or with Close welcome.

message.name: Status line
message.description: Shown with a gently pulsing dot while 'Pulse for' runs.

message_after.name: Status line after
message_after.description: Replaces the status line once the pulse ends.

cameras.name: Cameras
cameras.description: Up to three. They can only be watched through the screen while the welcome screen is up.

seconds.name: Close after
seconds.description: It closes by itself after this long.

note.name: Small print
note.description: Optional line at the bottom right.
